title: A day at the Cu Chi tunnels
duration: A day from Ho Chi Minh City
summary: Leave Ho Chi Minh City in the morning for Bến Dược, crawl the visitor section, and walk the memorial on the same ground. Be out before the 17:00 gate unless the night is Trăng chiến khu.

stops.name: Tunnel entrance

approach.note: By road from the city centre to Bến Dược, about one hour or about 70 km.

stops.note: Crawl the widened visitor section, about 120 meters, then walk the ground above it.

stops.name: Ben Duoc Temple

approach.note: Along the forest path from the tunnels.

stops.note: Walk the memorial hall and the tower on the same Bến Dược ground.

seoTitle: A day at the Cu Chi tunnels — one gate, then the city
seoDescription: A day from Ho Chi Minh City to Bến Dược, about one hour by road, for the tunnels and the memorial temple. The ordinary gate closes at 17:00.
